card.name: Punctuation inside lists of heart drugs
card.fires_on: Commas, "e.g.,", "and" or "to" right after a drug or treatment name in text about arrhythmia treatment. The next word is usually another drug or an example treatment.

modes.label: Comma in drug list
modes.description: A comma after an antiarrhythmic drug such as lidocaine, before the next drug in the list.
modes.example: may respond to lidocaine<<,>> bretylium or phenyto

modes.label: Examples and responses
modes.description: Punctuation or "to" that introduces an example treatment or a response to treatment.
